claim_boundary: Own RAD-seq can update the set of admissible histories but cannot by itself establish independent origins, convergence, function, adaptation or fitness. Meta-analysis is a bounded design prior, simulation failures apply only to frozen generators, and technical protocol readiness is not authorization or a biological result.
